mapper.select: SELECT d.LAST_DOWN_VER AS LAST_DOWN_VER , TRIM(d.FILE_PATH) AS FILE_PATH , d.FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE , TRIM(v.FILE_PATH) || '\' || TRIM(v.FILE_NAME) AS DOWN_PATH FROM T_DOWNLOAD_SERVER d LEFT JOIN T_AP_LAST_VERSION v ON d.ATM_CO_CD = v.ATM_CO_CD AND d.MODEL_CD = v.MODEL_CD JOIN T_ATM a ON d.ATM_CO_CD = a.ATM_CO_CD AND d.MODEL_CD = a.MODEL_CD AND a.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR} AND a.TERM_ID = #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ( v.CONFIRM_STEP = '1' AND v.LAST_DOWN_VER = d.LAST_DOWN_VER ) OR ( v.CONFIRM_STEP != '1' AND d.LAST_DOWN_VER = ( SELECT MAX(LAST_DOWN_VER) FROM T_DOWNLOAD_SERVER WHERE ATM_CO_CD = v.ATM_CO_CD AND LAST_DOWN_VER < v.LAST_DOWN_VER ) ) FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
